thread_text:
1. Record IPO, hidden cost

SK Hynix raised $26.5B in the largest foreign US IPO ever. But the cash came with strings attached: build US fabs now.

2. Wall Street blindsided

No one expected this record—not even Wall Street analysts. The scale caught everyone off guard.

3. New chip source

Your supply chain just gained a critical new US chip source. Memory production is shifting onshore.

4. Supply chain wake-up

This move reshapes global memory supply. Dependence on Asian fabs just got a hard check.

Is your memory supply diversified? If not, call your team today and audit your sources.

$26.5B—the biggest foreign IPO in US history—but the fine print says SK Hynix must build new American fabs now.

Wall Street analysts didn't see this record coming. Memory chip production is officially shifting onshore, giving your supply chain a direct new US source for critical components.

If you write about tech procurement or hardware, your next piece needs to address the geopolitical leverage shift away from Asian fabs.
